title: Universal Life Insurance Actuarial Computation Note: Overloan Protection Charge
content:
Computation of the one-time overloan protection charge on an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy.

**Computation.** The overloan protection charge is the account value shown at the latest monthly anniversary, as it stands on the policy record, times the tier's overloan charge percentage, rounded to the cent. The tier's overloan charge percentage is 3.5% (0.035) on every tier. The charge is rounded once, at the end; no intermediate figure is rounded.

| Quantity | Source |
|---|---|
| Account value | The policy record, as shown at the latest monthly anniversary |
| Overloan charge percentage | The tier's figure, 3.5% |
| Charge | Account value times the percentage, rounded once to the cent |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Account value | Times 0.035 | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| $200000.00 | $7000.000 | $7000.00 |
| $213457.89 | $7471.02615 | $7471.03 |
| $96420.40 | $3374.714 | $3374.71 |
